summary: Cheatsheet example of an ad hoc command that installs apache2 on localhost with the apt module, using become and a become-password prompt, plus sample output.
questions: How do I install a package on my own machine with a one-line ansible command?
What does -m do in an ad hoc ansible command?
How do I run an ad hoc apt install with sudo and a password prompt?

answer_card.title: Install a package with an ad hoc command
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible localhost -m ansible.builtin.apt -a "name=apache2 state=present" -b -K
```
- `localhost` targets your local system
- `-m` selects the module (`apt`)
- `-a` passes module options (`name=apache2 state=present`)
- `-b` uses become; `-K` prompts for the become password
